targets.query:
from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fortinet_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "uptime")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Uptime", _value: float(v: r._value) / 8640000.0 }))

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fortinet_system" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "cpu_pct")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "CPU" }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fortinet_processors" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field == "cpu_pct_1min")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "CPU " + r.index }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

panels.description: One-minute average load of every processor from fgProcessorTable (fgProcessorUsage1min). The previous version merged the 1-minute and 5-second series under the same label, which averaged them together. Dashed lines mark 70% and 90%.

  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interfaces" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and exists r.ifName and r.ifName !~ /(?i)^(mgmt|management|aux|hsci|ha($|[0-9-]))/ and r.ifName !~ /\./ and r.ifName !~ /(?i)^(a|b|modem|fortilink)$/ and (if exists r.ifType then r.ifType =~ /^(ethernetCsmacd|ethernetCsmacd\(6\)|6)$/ else r.ifName =~ /(?i)^(ethernet[0-9]+\/[0-9]+(\/[0-9]+)?|port[0-9]+|wan[0-9]*|lan[0-9]*|internal[0-9]*|dmz[0-9]*|x[0-9]+)$/) and (if exists r.ifConnectorPresent then r.ifConnectorPresent =~ /(?i)^(true|true\(1\)|1)$/ else true) and r._field =~ /^ifHC(In|Out)Octets$/)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "fortinet_processors" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and r._field =~ /^pkt_(tx_)?dropped$/)

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _field: "Drops", _value: r._value }))

  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Processor drops/s", _value: r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
errors = from(bucket: "firewalls")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interfaces" and r.hostname == "${hostname}" and exists r.ifName and r.ifName !~ /(?i)^(mgmt|management|aux|hsci|ha($|[0-9-]))/ and r.ifName !~ /\./ and r.ifName !~ /(?i)^(a|b|modem|fortilink)$/ and (if exists r.ifType then r.ifType =~ /^(ethernetCsmacd|ethernetCsmacd\(6\)|6)$/ else r.ifName =~ /(?i)^(ethernet[0-9]+\/[0-9]+(\/[0-9]+)?|port[0-9]+|wan[0-9]*|lan[0-9]*|internal[0-9]*|dmz[0-9]*|x[0-9]+)$/) and (if exists r.ifConnectorPresent then r.ifConnectorPresent =~ /(?i)^(true|true\(1\)|1)$/ else true) and r._field =~ /^if(In|Out)(Errors|Discards)$/)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _field: "Interface errors and discards/s", _value: r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
union(tables: [drops, errors])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])

import "array"

  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.hostname == "${hostname}" and ((r._measurement == "fortinet_system" and r._field == "ha_mode") or (r._measurement == "fortinet_vdoms" and r._field == "ha_state")))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._field == "ha_mode" then (if r._value == 1 then "Standalone" else if r._value == 2 then "Active-Active" else if r._value == 3 then "Active-Passive" else "Unknown") else (if r._value == 1 then "Primary" else if r._value == 2 then "Secondary" else if r._value == 3 then "Standalone" else "Unknown") }))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: if (exists r.ha_mode and r.ha_mode == "Standalone") or (exists r.ha_state and r.ha_state == "Standalone") then "Standalone" else if exists r.ha_mode and exists r.ha_state then r.ha_mode + " / " + r.ha_state else "Standalone" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

union(tables: [array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"), _value: "Standalone"}]), ha])
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
